entities.summary: Charles V, a notable figure in the history of Venezuela, associated with European Contact, the Welser Colony, and Early Colonization (1528–1546). Preceded by Welser banking family granted Province of Venezuela and Vespucci/Ojeda name the region 'Venezuela' (Little Venice). Their legacy influenced Welser concession revoked by Spain and Colonial Settlement and the Cacao Economy.
